backlog.title: One Virgo Ex Is Not a Virgo Rule
backlog.hook: One Virgo ex does not define every Virgo relationship.
backlog.angle: Virgo | Single AI host | Use one continuous narration, not character dialogue. Start with how one painful relationship becomes a rule about an entire sign, then contrast it with a different lived example of consistent care. Land on the idea that astrology may name a pattern, but observable behavior decides whether a relationship is healthy. Keep the language gender-neutral and non-diagnostic.
backlog.why_now: checked_at=2026-08-24; research topic miraa-virgo-behavior-is-not-destiny is supported by verified source src-4b653b6b36, a directly readable Reddit body and comment thread last verified 2026-08-18 with 989 visible upvotes and 160 comments. The thread contains sharply different Virgo relationship experiences, so it supports a behavior-over-label angle rather than a universal claim. Dedupe: unlike the existing Virgo practical-care item and the accuracy-versus-hurt item, this tests whether viewers generalize one ex into a sign rule. The evidence is one platform, anecdotal and partly gendered; the candidate itself stays gender-neutral.
backlog.route_reason: Evergreen Route C; one host can deliver the stereotype-versus-behavior contrast while keeping Miraa's current avatar, voice and visual baseline fixed.

backlog.title: Why Scorpio Reopens the Argument Later
backlog.hook: Scorpio looks calm in the fight, then replays every word later.
backlog.angle: Scorpio | Single AI host | Use one continuous narration, not character dialogue. Explain that visible calm during conflict can be delayed processing rather than a lack of feeling. Show the useful version: Scorpio returns after processing, admits what mattered and repairs the issue. Keep the counter-view explicit: replaying the conflict without communicating becomes avoidance or scorekeeping, not repair.
backlog.why_now: checked_at=2026-08-24; research topic miraa-scorpio-冲突处理 is supported by verified sources src-f026911d7f and src-fffddd7467. The first is a directly readable Instagram body/comment thread published 2026-08-17 with visible engagement recorded as 81.7K/530 and comments about looking calm while feeling intensely and reacting after analysis; the second is a directly readable Instagram post published 2026-08-01 with visible engagement recorded as 2K/3 and a clear accountability-and-repair counterpoint. Dedupe: unlike the pending Scorpio pull-away-after-closeness and support-during-a-rough-patch items, this tests post-conflict processing followed by explicit repair. Both sources are qualitative Instagram evidence, so the pattern is not treated as universal.
backlog.route_reason: Evergreen Route C; a single host can explain the delayed-processing-to-repair sequence without adding a second character or changing the production baseline.
